payout_quote: Offer good on new SCHEELS Visa accounts only, subject to credit approval. If instantly approved, a $75 offer will be added to your MySCHEELS account for use online or in-store with a new SCHEELS Visa. Allow up to 48 hours to receive the offer.
steps: Apply online through the scheels.com Visa page and be approved (issued by First National Bank of Omaha; $0 annual fee)
If instantly approved, the $75 offer is added to your MySCHEELS account within 48 hours
Use the offer online or in store toward SCHEELS purchases
catches: SCHEELS-store credit, not cash - savings on planned gear/apparel spending, not income
Credit approval required; application triggers a hard inquiry
Offers may vary depending on where you apply (online vs in person) - the online offer is the $75 one
Never spend extra just to chase the bonus - never buy gear just to get the discount
Annual-fee net math: $0 annual fee, so the $75 is net of fees - as long as you pay in full
Balance-carrying/APR risk: standard variable purchase APR wipes the $75 savings if a balance is carried - pay the statement balance in full
biggest_catch: $75 of SCHEELS-only credit for opening a store card - real savings on planned sporting-goods spending, but never spend extra to chase it.
eligibility: Approved SCHEELS Visa account holder; new accounts only; MySCHEELS account
timing: $75 offer added within 48 hours of instant approval; use online or in store.
